task.question: Who entered negotiations with the Trump administration on March 13, 2026?
task.evidence: March 13 - First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba Miguel Díaz-Canel entered negotiations with the Trump administration in an effort to end the United States embargo against Cuba.

answer: FINAL: Cuba, led by President Miguel Díaz-Canel, entered negotiations with the Trump administration on March 13, 2026. On that date, Díaz-Canel confirmed that Cuban officials had been in talks with the U.S. government, and Cuba announced it would release 51 prisoners in the coming days as part of ongoing discussions.
